subject: Money
title: Fear-Based Spending
description: A short lesson to help you apply Fear-Based Spending.

hook.text: After 9/11, gun sales spiked 10%. After every recession, gold sales surge. Fear opens wallets.

buildup.text: Fear activates the amygdala, which overrides the prefrontal cortex. Rational budgeting shuts down.

discovery.text: Insurance companies know this. They sell peace of mind, not probability. Fear makes math irrelevant.

twist.text: Scarcity marketing is manufactured fear. 'Only 2 left!' creates urgency that bypasses evaluation.

climax.text: Fear spending feels urgent but is usually regrettable. The threat passes; the purchase stays.

quiz.question: What brain region does fear activate during spending?
